newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks seen rising, backed by Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks seen rising, backed by Wall Street.

text.p: Tokyo stocks are expected to rise in Thursday's session after the Dow industrials surged overnight to close above the 8,000 mark for the first time, brokers said.
They said that investors were likely to continue seeking high-technology issues, which have been buoying the Tokyo market lately, tracking Nasdaq which also ended with solid gains.
On Wednesday, the Nikkei 225 closed at 20,358.74, up 289.33 points or 1.44 percent. Its September futures added 360 points to finish the trading session at 20,430.

"Nikkei 225 futures in Chicago ended above 20,500 and Tokyo stocks will try to catch up," a broker at a major securities house said. "But for the index to rise further, near 21,000, the buying has to spread to domestic issues as well."
Overnight, the Dow finished 63 points or 0.79 percent higher at 8,039, taking just five months to rise from the 7,000 level passed on February 13.
The Nasdaq composite scored its biggest single-day rise, jumping 38.5 percent or 2.5 percent to 1,581.
